summary: 3DNow!-based barycentric interpolation. Builds four edge expressions from scalar dwords of the a2 vertex-component table (a2[0], a2[2], a2[5]), classifies the query into one of four triangle regions with a packed float-compare byte mask, and in each region normalizes an interpolation edge via pfrsqrt + Newton-Raphson refinement scaled by the 0.5 constant, blends the three vertex attributes (a2[1], a2[3], a2[4]) into the two-qword output a1 (with a sign-flip XOR 0x8000000000000000 in two of the inner regions), then clears MMX state with _m_femms() and returns a1.

operations.description: Load scalar components from the a2 vertex-component table into packed 64-bit operands: high dword of a2[2] into v2 and low dword of a2[5] into v3, then form the four edge expressions v4/v5/v6/v7 from a2[0] via packed-float pfadd/pfsub/pfsubr.
Build a packed comparison byte mask v13: combine edges with pfcmpge, unpack with punpckldq, and pack via packssdw/packsswb to classify which triangle region the query falls in.
Branch on (v13 & 1): set selects the inner-region path, clear selects the outer-region path.
Within the inner path, branch on (v13 & 0xFF00FF00) == 0xFF00FF00 to select the third inner region block.
Within the inner path when the 0xFF00FF00 test fails, branch on (v13 & 0x10000) to select the second inner region block, else the first inner region block.

Per-region normalize: pfadd the selected edge with the [-1.0, 1.0] literal 0xBF8000003F800000, compute the reciprocal square root with pfrsqrt, refine with the Newton-Raphson step (pfrsqit1 on the squared value, pfrcpit2), and scale by the 0.5 literal 0x3F0000003F000000 to produce the normalized weight vector. The read-only globals back the inlined 3DNow! constants.

Blend the three vertex attributes: pack dwords from a2[1], a2[3], a2[4] (and a2[2]) into a pair, and in the two inner regions flip signs with XOR against the literal 0x8000000000000000, then scale by the normalized weight.
Write the normalized interpolated xy result (v25/v30/v35/v20) into the first output qword at a1+0x0.
Write the blended and scaled vertex-attribute result into the second output qword at a1+0x8.
Clear the MMX/3DNow! register state with _m_femms() before returning so the x87 FPU can be used again.
